release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.14

The program name is LockStepPDF.

Page size is one setting for the job. The color window has one Apply button. The feedback form submits again.

The asset list shows Pagemix in the Size column, a measurement note, and book and sheet icons. The green dot follows the monitor. Existing bleed can be shown. Recycle repaginates the file. A parent file can be deleted. Image files show in the monitor, and the list scrolls across files.

The recipe library and the production destination start empty when a job loads. Blank pages are labeled Blank. Sepia has its new name, and the asset list has a color column. Bleed can be set on each page. Undo keeps a snapshot of the steps. The stack grip sets how tall the step list is the first time the window opens.
